item.title: zizonline.com: 70. The gap: HSTS.
item.description:
Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
The lesson for every team: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
One automated analysis of public pages on 26 Oct 2026, one of the most visited sites in its country, from QA-lab URL Review's country sweep. A starting point, not a verdict. The full report: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html?live=u-zizonline-com&utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=country-sweep&utm_content=u-zizonline-com

item.title: We analyzed GOV.UK. It scores 92.
item.description:
Accessibility 100, a strict content security policy, and real visitors see the main content in 0.7 s. The one gap: 19 of the 20 pages analyzed have no canonical link.
The lesson for every team: Give every page a canonical link, even when only one address serves it. One line settles which URL ranks.

item.title: Valle del Cauca locks the pinch-zoom.
item.description:
HSTS runs a full year, framing is limited, and cookies are Secure. But the viewport tag says user-scalable=no, so people who need larger text cannot pinch to zoom on a phone.
The lesson for every team: Drop user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag, so people can zoom to at least 200%.
One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-3-2027-01&utm_content=valle

item.title: ILO: secure and fast, but no entity markup.
item.description:
security.txt is published, HSTS covers subdomains, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But no page analyzed carries JSON-LD, so the Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube profiles it links are never tied to the ILO.
The lesson for every team: Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.
One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-3-2027-01&utm_content=ilo
